What we do

Three services.
One specialist to deliver them.

Brokerage, logistics, maritime, and hospitality - four industries, three services (system integration, workflow automation, analytics), one specialist. Fixed timelines, measurable results, from day one.

System Integrations

Your tools don't talk to each other. That means double-entry, missed data, and constant firefighting. I connect your platforms so information flows automatically - no more copy-paste between systems.

  • ERP, CRM & accounting connectors
  • Booking platform unification
  • Payment gateway & banking API connectors
  • Custom middleware & webhooks
Business Automation

Every hour your team spends on repetitive manual tasks is an hour not spent on clients. I identify your highest-cost manual workflows and automate them - process automation that runs in the background, usually live within weeks, not months.

  • Document generation & routing
  • Invoice & compliance workflows
  • Alert & notification pipelines
  • Scheduled reporting & reconciliation
Optional AI augmentation
Analytics Dashboards

Real decisions require real data - not a report that arrives three days later. I build live dashboards and interactive data visualizations that surface the numbers your leadership actually needs, updated in real time.

  • Executive & operational KPI views
  • Fleet tracking & utilisation metrics
  • Revenue & occupancy analytics
  • Custom alerts & threshold triggers
Optional AI augmentation

Industries

Deep expertise where
the problems are real.

I don't try to serve everyone. I go deep in four industries where the problems are clear and the returns on fixing them are significant.

Industry 01 · Maritime & Shipping
Ship Management & Maritime Ops

Europe’s ship management sector handles some of the world’s most complex global operations - yet most companies still run compliance, crew management, and voyage reporting on PDFs and email threads.

Common pain points we solve
  • Fleet data scattered across multiple systems with no single view
  • Compliance docs tracked manually - flags, certs, crew records
  • Voyage P&L reconciliation done in spreadsheets, days late
  • Port agents & head office using entirely different tools
What I deliver
  • Unified fleet dashboard - live position, status, document alerts
  • Compliance automation - expiry tracking and auto-routing
  • Voyage P&L integration - real-time financials from your ERP
  • Supplier & port agent workflow automation
Industry 02 · Hospitality & Tourism
Hotels, Resorts & Tour Operators

Europe welcomed over 600 million tourists last year. Yet most properties are still manually reconciling Booking.com, Expedia, and their own systems - making pricing decisions on yesterday’s data.

Common pain points we solve
  • Revenue fragmented across OTAs, PMS, and accounting software
  • No real-time visibility into occupancy, ADR, or RevPAR
  • Manual guest communication and check-in workflows
  • Seasonal forecasting done on gut feel, not historical data
What I deliver
  • Revenue management dashboard - unified OTA + direct view
  • Automated guest journey workflows - booking to checkout
  • Live occupancy & rate intelligence across your portfolio
  • Seasonal demand analytics and automated reporting
Industry 03 · Logistics & Supply Chain
Freight, 3PLs & Distribution Networks

Logistics operators run on three things at once - the warehouse system, the carrier portal, and the customer’s expectation that their order arrived on time. Most of the friction lives between those three places. That’s where I work.

Common pain points we solve
  • Order, WMS and TMS data living in separate systems - no single shipment view
  • Carrier rates and accessorials reconciled by hand against invoices each month
  • Customer service chasing carrier portals to answer "where’s my order?"
  • Manifests, customs docs and proof-of-delivery scattered across emails and PDFs
What I deliver
  • Unified shipment dashboard - WMS, TMS, carriers and storefront in one live view
  • Automated freight audit - rates, accessorials and surcharges matched to contracts
  • AI-powered ETA and exception alerts - notify customers before they call
  • Document automation - manifests, customs and PODs captured and routed automatically
Industry 04 · Brokerage & Trading
Brokers, Wealth Desks & Multi-Asset Platforms

From MiFID II-licensed CFD and FX brokers to multi-asset wealth platforms, brokerage firms juggle trading venues, CRMs, payment processors and regulators - all while clients expect instant onboarding and constant transparency. I bring automation and AI clarity to the entire broker stack - so your team stops stitching spreadsheets and starts compounding clients.

Common pain points we solve
  • Trading platforms (MT4/MT5, cTrader), CRM and back office living in silos - no single client view
  • KYC, suitability and AML onboarding causing days of delay and dropped sign-ups
  • Trade & transaction reporting (MiFIR, EMIR, ASIC RG) wrangled in spreadsheets every cycle
  • Introducing-broker and affiliate commissions calculated by hand - errors, disputes, late payouts
What I deliver
  • Unified broker dashboard - trading platform, CRM, PSPs and back office in one live view
  • AI-powered onboarding - document parsing, suitability scoring, KYC routing in minutes not days
  • Automated trade & transaction reporting - MiFIR, EMIR and ASIC RG outputs, audit-ready
  • Client retention AI - flag at-risk accounts, score lifetime value, brief the dealing desk
